purpose: Diagnostic evidence for ADR-0121; not a runtime contract or a speedup promise

trace_origins.extraction: Persisted rollout event_msg/item_completed: tool identity, duration, started_at_ms and completed_at_ms only; child lifecycle from session_meta and task_complete; no semantic bodies retained

receipt_observations.basis: Committed receipt state and filesystem last-write time; historical observation, not current progress authority

snapshot_probe.isolation: Copied workspace and source; original logical paths mapped to copied filesystem paths; state writes restricted to the copy
snapshot_probe.runtime: Local Bun source execution with CPU sampling and synchronous filesystem-call counters

limitations: The source worktree was dirty; HEAD alone does not reconstruct the measured executable or source snapshot.
The profiling copy was obtained while other work could continue; it is not a frozen end-to-end A/B starting state.
The copied filesystem is on the temp drive and includes path-redirection/counter overhead; timings are not exact installed-process attribution.
Failed preliminary probes are excluded. Only two successful full snapshot runs are reported; they are not a median or p95.
Tool durations are outer wall times. Per-call server/residual timing for the real book was not joined in this diagnosis.
Driver time, child tool time and lifecycle intervals overlap and must not be added as disjoint wall time.
Child occupancy includes waiting on tools; it is not CPU or model-generation utilization.
Temporary profiles and local rollouts may be removed. B1 must provide a reproducible representative fixture; no book text or candidate is stored here.
